title: HalfEdgeMesh gets flipEdge/collapseEdge/splitFace and attribute layers with an inherit-on-split policy; EmbeddedMeshTopology stops re-implementing remeshing
description:
Repo plan phase 4.1, merge 3C.13: the fix the user asked for in CRAW-70 ('fix the halfmesh underlying datastructure' instead of fast paths in EmbeddedMeshTopology). HalfEdgeMesh's editing API is add/remove vertex/edge/face plus splitEdge (HalfEdgeMesh.java:133-246): no flip, collapse or face split, no per-element attributes. EmbeddedMeshTopology (quadlayout/embedding/records, 1047 lines) is a HalfEdgeMesh copy plus about 12 hand-maintained parallel arrays (sourceFaceByCopyFace, sourceEdgeByCopyEdge, ownerArcByCopyEdge/Vertex, ownerNodeByCopyVertex, patchByCopyFace + a union-find, lengthByCopyEdge, vacatedWall stamps, barycentrics; :44-130) and re-implements flipEdge (:506-523, retire two faces and add two), splitFaceAtPoint (:435), splitEdgeAtPoint (:462) and insertChord (:539) to keep them in step. ArcNetwork is the only writer. Add the operators to HalfEdgeMesh/HalfEdgeMeshEngine and typed attribute layers (vertex, edge, face, corner) that declare how they propagate on split, flip and collapse; EmbeddedMeshTopology keeps its name and shrinks to the provenance/barycentric overlay built on them. The measurement helpers in HalfEdgeMesh (:1052-1236) may move to a utility on the way only if it reduces the class without a single-caller helper.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. HalfEdgeMesh/Engine provide flipEdge, collapseEdge and splitFace with tests (manifold checks, twin consistency, attribute propagation).
2. EmbeddedMeshTopology no longer contains its own flip/split/chord implementations or hand-propagated arrays; its data lives in attribute layers.
3. Quad-suite fingerprints byte-identical to master (or every difference explained and accepted by the user); seamless and embedding timings not worse (measured).
4. Launch entry and screenshot of the embedded T-mesh scene.
testing-plan:
1. New HalfEdgeMesh operator tests.
2. Quad-suite fingerprint and timing run before and after.
3. Live: EmbeddedTMesh and MotorcycleGraphExamination scenes.
unknowns: Embedding relies on child-face insertion order (copyFacesBySourceFace) and edge-id reuse; the operators must keep ids stable or the embedding must stop depending on them.
changes-made:
Design (MESH-59 agent, before code). Baseline recorded: quad suite tmp/quad-suite/mesh-59-before (matches mesh-58-after on all 14 meshes), DSL fixtures/ring/dungeon/timing sweeps under the worktree's tmp/mesh59-*-base.*.
OPERATORS (HalfEdgeMeshEngine, HalfEdgeMesh wrappers): replaceFaces(parentFaceId, retiredFaceIds[], triangleCorners[]) removes the faces in order (reaping isolated edges), adds the triangles in order, and is the one primitive under flipEdge(edgeId) (two triangles -> the opposite diagonal; throws on a boundary edge, non-triangle, or an existing opposite diagonal) and splitFace(faceId, position) (a fan of n triangles around one new vertex). Ids follow today's EmbeddedMeshTopology exactly: retired faces leave their ids, new faces and the new diagonal take fresh ids in creation order, surviving edges keep theirs. That is what keeps the embedding's child-face order and edge ids, so the quad suite can stay byte-identical; in-place rewiring would change both and is left out. splitEdge stays in place as now. collapseEdge(edgeId, position) is new (no embedding caller): keeps the canonical start vertex, refuses a link-condition violation, rebuilds the end vertex's fan onto the kept vertex.
LAYERS: int layers stored as parallel arrays on HalfEdgeMesh (vertexLayers/edgeLayers/faceLayers int[][] plus a fill per layer), grown in ensure*Capacity, declared with declareVertexLayer(fill, splitEdgeLayer), declareEdgeLayer(fill), declareFaceLayer(fill). Propagation is fixed per kind: every new face inherits its parent face's values (split children, both flip faces from the canonical half-edge's face, replaceFaces' named parent, collapse's rebuilt fan); both halves of a split edge inherit, other new edges get the fill, and an edge reaped and re-created between the same two vertices (or, under collapse, its end-vertex twin) gets its old values back; a vertex minted on a split edge takes the edge layer it names, otherwise the fill; collapse keeps the survivor's values. No corner layers: nothing consumes one (the barycentrics are per vertex per source face, not per copy corner) and the barycentric overlay stays in EmbeddedMeshTopology as the ticket says.
EMBEDDED MESH TOPOLOGY keeps its name; sourceFace and patch become face layers, sourceEdge and ownerArc edge layers, ownerNode and ownerArc vertex layers (ownerArc minted on a split edge from the edge layer). The fields become same-named accessors returning the layer array (topology.ownerArcByCopyEdge()[e]), so the ~200 call sites change mechanically and writes keep their form; patchByCopyFace.length==0 becomes a patchCoversLabeled flag. Its split/flip/chord methods keep their barycentric work and call the mesh operators; it keeps only copyFacesBySourceFace (provenance index, updated from the retired ids and the new face ids in ascending order, which is today's insertion order) and the barycentrics. Removed as dead: the four public split/flip/collapse counters, the vacated-wall stamps (no caller), splitFaceAtPoint/splitEdgeAtPoint, edgeIdBound. The edge-length memo is kept unchanged for the byte-identical step, then dropped in its own step: it is stale after splitEdge (the split edge keeps its id and its memoised full length), so dropping it may change routes; that step is measured and reported separately.

Implemented (uncommitted in worktree mesh-59). HalfEdgeMeshEngine gains replaceFaces/splitFace/flipEdge/collapseEdge (HalfEdgeMesh wrappers) and int attribute layers on HalfEdgeMesh (vertexLayers/edgeLayers/faceLayers + fills, vertexLayerSplitEdgeLayer), grown in ensure*Capacity and propagated by splitEdge and the new operators as designed; collapseEdge refuses link-condition, interior-edge-between-boundary-vertices and duplicate-face cases. New HalfEdgeMeshOperatorsTest (8 tests: full twin/next/prev/row/fan consistency check after each operator, counts, refusals, layer propagation incl. re-created boundary edges and collapse merges). EmbeddedMeshTopology: 1047 -> ~880 lines; sourceFace/patch/sourceEdge/ownerArc(edge)/ownerNode/ownerArc(vertex) are copy layers read through same-named accessors; flipEdge/splitEdgeAtParameter/splitFaceAtBarycentric/rebuildStrip call the mesh operators; retireFace/adoptFace/ensure*Capacity/splitFaceAtPoint/splitEdgeAtPoint, the vacated-wall stamps (no caller), the four split/flip/collapse counters (no reader), edgeIdBound and the edge-length memo are gone; patchByCopyFace.length==0 became patchCoversLabeled. Kept: barycentric overlay, copyFacesBySourceFace (updated from retired ids + new ids in creation order). Step 1 (memo kept): quad suite 14/14 byte-identical to tmp/quad-suite/mesh-59-before, DSL fixtures sweep, ring fingerprints/regions and dungeon fingerprints identical. Step 2 (memo dropped): the memo was stale after splitEdge (the split edge keeps its id and its memoised full length), so routes now read true lengths: 9 meshes' signatures and screenshots differ (tmp/quad-suite/mesh-59-step2), e.g. buddha [snap] passages 42238->42233, recarve copy V 147948->147946; every final quad count and Euler characteristic unchanged (hand 13096, elk 12586, feline 11174, fertility 11582, botijo 14444, block 22158, rockerarm 11602, buddha 21620); fixtures/rings/dungeons still identical. Needs the user's acceptance per DoD 3. Timings, interleaved base (eng-31) vs change, 4 rounds each, medians ms: rockerarm seamless 1624->1406, embed 580->519, contract 1141->903; buddha seamless 3520->3384, embed 1190->1313, contract 1537->1606; an alternating async-profiler A/B on buddha shows the new operator frames at 4-10 samples and run-to-run swings larger than the deltas (packedBuild, untouched, moves as much), so no regression is attributable. Unit suite 538/538.

2026-10-18 user decisions: the output change from dropping the stale edge-length cache (9 quad-suite meshes route slightly differently, quad counts and Euler characteristics unchanged) is accepted as the new baseline; the replacedEdge* scratch fields stay public.
review-summary: HalfEdgeMesh gains flip, split and collapse operators that carry per-element data along with each edit. The quad-layout embedding now uses them instead of its own private copies, so later mesh tickets build on one editing API.
